title: Memory leak and unreadable text in Run
author: CircuitDaemon

confidence.rationale: Normalized from legacy Medium confidence label.

summary: The reproducible long-query overlap is the known PowerToys Run autocomplete rendering defect; the reported memory growth is unproven by the supplied diagnostics and predates the released stale-query worker-lifetime fix.

judgment.rationale: The exact query and screenshots establish a known visual overlap, while the memory observation is from PowerToys 0.97.2. The maintainer confirms that the later Run worker-lifetime fix covers the known memory mechanism and is included in stable 0.101.2362.0. The supplied diagnostics do not prove that mechanism caused this report, and the visual defect remains separately tracked. A current-release retest is therefore needed before any new memory fix is proposed.
evidence: The report includes an exact long query, overlap screenshots, a diagnostic archive, a text attachment, and a screenshot of high PowerToys Run memory.
Issue 13554 remains the canonical long-input autocomplete-alignment tracker.
LauncherControl.xaml overlays QueryTextBox and AutoCompleteTextBlock while the TextBox content scrolls independently.
The supplied diagnostic has no process dump, ETL, GC dump, runtime trace, thread timeline, or memory timeline; its current PowerToys Run log records startup and restart only.
PR 48394 fixed stale-query worker accumulation and is included in the latest stable 0.101.2362.0; the reported installation is 0.97.2.
A maintainer comment on 2026-09-04 directs the reporter to update because the Window Walker memory issue was fixed several months ago.
judgment.recommended_action: Keep the visual symptom with Issue 13554 and request a current-stable, time-series memory and thread retest; only investigate a new memory defect if growth persists after update and dismissal.

fix_assessment.rationale: PR 48394 concretely fixes the stale-query worker accumulation mechanism that can cause Run worker and memory growth and is in the latest stable release, matching the maintainer's direction. It does not fix the separately tracked visual layout defect or prove this report used that mechanism; that portion needs a current-release retest.

issue_context.summary: A long mixed-character Run query visibly overlaps the autocomplete text; after repeated editing, the reporter observed severe memory growth on a version predating later query-worker lifetime work.
known_information: The report targets PowerToys 0.97.2 on Windows 11 build 26200.
The mixed-character query produces the visual overlap after one more character.
The issue includes a screenshot showing substantial memory attributed to PowerToys Run.
The diagnostic archive includes no heap or runtime trace establishing memory retention.
PR 48394 is merged and included in the latest stable 0.101.2362.0.
A maintainer advised updating to the latest version because the reported memory issue was fixed several months ago.
inferences: The visual symptom is another instance of Issue 13554.
The separate stationary autocomplete surface likely contributes to the visual overlap.
The memory symptom is likely covered by PR 48394, but no evidence ties this occurrence to its stale-query worker mechanism.
The visual defect and memory growth are not established as one root cause.
issue_context.analysis: The issue combines two mechanisms that must not be conflated. The visual symptom follows the existing independent autocomplete rendering path and belongs with Issue 13554. The historical memory observation may be the stale-query worker accumulation fixed after 0.97.2, consistent with the maintainer's update guidance, but the supplied archive cannot establish that. A current-release time series is the narrow evidence needed before a new memory investigation.
initial_investigation: Read the complete issue, its new maintainer comment, timeline, screenshots, text attachment, and diagnostic archive.
Reviewed Issue 13554 and related duplicate history.
Inspected LauncherControl.xaml, MainWindow.xaml.cs, MainViewModel.cs, and autocomplete tests.
Reviewed PR 48394, its worker-lifetime behavior, release containment, and focused QuerySession tests.
Inspected CustomSearchBox, LauncherControl, MainWindow autocomplete handlers, MainViewModel autocomplete helpers, and current WPF test coverage.

Confirmed ownership signals: the report is labeled Issue-Bug and Needs-Triage, has no assignee, and the maintainer points to the existing Run fix and current-release retest rather than a new owner or implementation.

information_gaps.information: Whether memory and thread growth still reproduce on stable 0.101.2362.0 or newer, including the repetition count, input cadence, PowerToys.PowerLauncher process ID, private bytes or private working set, thread count at idle baseline, at peak during the edits, immediately after clearing the query, immediately after dismissing Run, about one minute later, and whether the text overlap still remains.
information_gaps.why_needed: This distinguishes the older fixed memory mechanism from any new current-release memory defect while preserving whether the visible overlap still reproduces.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Update to the latest stable build, repeat the supplied long-query edit for 10 to 15 seconds, and record the requested measurements plus whether the overlap remains.

information_gaps.information: A fresh PowerToys diagnostic ZIP only if memory or thread counts remain elevated after dismissing Run on the current stable build.
information_gaps.why_needed: A fresh archive is only needed if the current-release retest still shows persistent growth after dismissal.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: If memory or thread counts remain elevated after dismissal, add a comment containing /bugreport immediately after reproducing on the current stable build.

actions.label: Request current-release Run retest

comment.body:
Thanks for the exact query, screenshots, log, and diagnostic ZIP. The overlapping long-input text is already tracked separately, and the older memory symptom may already be covered by the later worker-lifetime fix that shipped after 0.97.2. Please provide:

1. A current-stable retest on 0.101.2362.0 or newer: repeat the supplied long-query edit for 10 to 15 seconds and report the repetition count, input cadence, PowerToys.PowerLauncher process ID, private bytes or private working set, thread count at idle baseline, at peak during the edits, immediately after clearing the query, immediately after dismissing Run, about one minute later, and whether the text overlap still remains.
2. A fresh PowerToys diagnostic ZIP only if memory or thread counts remain elevated after dismissal: if they do, add a comment containing "/bugreport" immediately after reproducing on the current stable build.

reproduce.title: Verify long-query autocomplete rendering in PowerToys Run
prerequisites: A completion-capable Run result is available
setup: Open PowerToys Run with its configured hotkey.
steps: Enter one additional character while the input exceeds the visible width.
Repeat the edit for 10 to 15 seconds, then clear and dismiss Run.
reproduce.expected_result: Autocomplete text must not overlap visible query glyphs. Process memory and thread count should stabilize after clearing and dismissal.
reproduce.setup_prompt: Use the exact long mixed-character query from Issue 50293 on a current stable PowerToys Run build and record the process counters at the stated checkpoints.

design_decision.reason: Released memory fix coverage exists; the remaining visual symptom needs retest rather than a second full design.
